subject: Discovery follow-up & demo scheduling / reschedule
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@upscale.ai>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 1 Jun 2026 16:02:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery follow-up & demo scheduling

Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today to walk through your goals on search relevance and cost per inference. Quick recap:
- Primary goal: reduce latency for reranking pipeline while cutting inference spend by ~30%
- Key constraints: must support private VPC deployment and SOC 2 controls for logging
- Next step we agreed on: technical deep dive/demo with infra + model leads to validate integration points and throughput expectations

Proposed 60-min slots for the demo (PT):
- Wed Jun 3, 10:00-11:00 AM PT
- Thu Jun 4, 9:00-10:00 AM PT
- Thu Jun 4, 2:00-3:00 PM PT

I've attached a short product overview (redwood_product_overview.pdf) to give the infra folks a quick idea of our routing and caching model. Can you confirm the best slot today? If helpful, here is a one-click scheduler: https://cal.com/redwood/demo?cid=DEAL-3891

To keep things tight, if I don't hear back by EOD tomorrow I can hold the Wed 10am slot for 24 hours and then open it up. Also please confirm who from your side will attend (names + roles).

Thanks — looking forward to the next step.
—Marissa
Marissa Cole
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.com
(415) 555-0172

Attachment: redwood_product_overview.pdf

From: Alex Jenkins <alex.jenkins@upscale.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 09:24:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & demo scheduling

Hey Marissa —

Apologies — I had an internal all-hands run over and missed the timing to respond. Appreciate the recap and the options.

We definitely want the technical deep dive, but Thu is looking tight for our infra lead. Would Fri Jun 5 11:00-12:00 PT or Mon Jun 8 9:00-10:00 PT work for your team? Also Priya Singh (Platform Lead) will join and possibly another SRE.

If neither of those work, quick ask: could you hold Wed Jun 3 10am for another 24 hours and I will confirm by tomorrow morning?

Thanks,
Alex
Alex Jenkins
Head of Platform, Upscale AI
alex.jenkins@upscale.ai

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>

Cc: Rachel Kim <rachel.kim@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 2 Jun 2026 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery follow-up & demo scheduling

Thanks for the update Alex — no problem.

We can do both Fri Jun 5 11:00-12:00 PT and Mon Jun 8 9:00-10:00 PT on our side. Two items to keep the booking tight:
1) Please confirm the preferred slot by EOB tomorrow (Wed Jun 3 11:59 PM PT). If we don't receive confirmation we'll release the slots and follow up again — want to avoid back-and-forth.
2) Can you confirm attendee list (Priya + any SREs) so we can route the right folks (I'll include Rachel for infra + Neha for quantization/throughput tuning).

I can also send a calendar invite once you confirm the slot. If you'd rather use the one-click scheduler, here's the link again: https://cal.com/redwood/demo?cid=DEAL-3891

Looping in Rachel and Neha so they can prep the short agenda (throughput targets, data handling, integration touchpoints).

Thanks — Marissa
